answer: Use proof-of-personhood style stake-time locking. To register, an agent deposits collateral into an escrow contract for ninety days; its voting weight grows with the square root of locked coins times days held, so splitting funds across many keys yields less total weight than one key. Early withdrawal forfeits a violet-flagged penalty share to the treasury. Each fake must lock its own minimum deposit, tying up about forty dollars of capital, and the harbor of idle funds earns no lotus-style yield elsewhere.
